_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in with the real column names from discovery.txt. config.json holds a secret, so keep it out of any shared folder.

sql._comment: Leave user/password empty to connect as the scheduled task's Windows account. That account only needs db_datareader.

_queryNotes: Every query must return a column named his_id.
Include changed_at when the table has a modification column; the agent uses it to pick up edits, not just new rows.
@LastId and @LastChangedAt are supplied by the agent from the website's cursor. @Top is the batch size.
Dates may be nvarchar Jalali in Bina. List those columns in jalaliColumns and the agent converts them before sending.
Patient mobile column in Bina is MobileTel (not MobileNo).
Real clinic money is Accounting.CashPayment + Accounting.Payment — NOT AdmissionAccountingBundle.

patients.query: SELECT TOP (@Top) p.Id AS his_id, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.FirstName,N'') + N' ' + ISNULL(p.LastName,N''))) AS name, p.NationalCode AS national_code, p.MobileTel AS mobile, p.InsertDate AS changed_at FROM PID.Patient p WHERE (@LastId IS NULL OR p.Id > TRY_CAST(@LastId AS bigint)) ORDER BY p.Id ASC

appointments.query: SELECT TOP (@Top) a.Id AS his_id, a.PatientId AS his_patient_id, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.FirstName,N'') + N' ' + ISNULL(p.LastName,N''))) AS patient_name, p.NationalCode AS national_code, p.MobileTel AS mobile, a.AppointmentDate AS scheduled_date, a.AppointmentTime AS scheduled_time, a.Status AS status, a.Description AS reason, a.InsertDate AS changed_at FROM Plan.Appointment a JOIN PID.Patient p ON p.Id = a.PatientId WHERE (@LastId IS NULL OR a.Id > TRY_CAST(@LastId AS bigint)) ORDER BY a.Id ASC

visits.query: SELECT TOP (@Top) g.Id AS his_id, g.PatientId AS his_patient_id, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.FirstName,N'') + N' ' + ISNULL(p.LastName,N''))) AS patient_name, p.NationalCode AS national_code, p.MobileTel AS mobile, g.InsertDate AS visited_at, g.InsertDate AS changed_at FROM Admission.GeneralAdmission g JOIN PID.Patient p ON p.Id = g.PatientId WHERE (@LastId IS NULL OR g.Id > TRY_CAST(@LastId AS bigint)) ORDER BY g.Id ASC

finance._comment: One row per CashPayment/Payment. Do not use AdmissionAccountingBundle — that is not clinic cash.
finance.query: SELECT TOP (@Top) CAST(p.Id AS nvarchar(64)) AS his_id, CAST(a.PatientId AS nvarchar(64)) AS his_patient_id, CAST(a.Id AS nvarchar(64)) AS his_admission_id, LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(pt.FirstName,N'') + N' ' + ISNULL(pt.LastName,N''))) AS patient_name, pt.NationalCode AS national_code, pt.MobileTel AS mobile, N'payment' AS type, CAST(ROUND(ISNULL(p.Amount, 0), 0) AS bigint) AS amount, CASE ISNULL(p.PaymentType, 0) WHEN 1 THEN N'pos' WHEN 2 THEN N'cash' WHEN 3 THEN N'wallet' ELSE N'other' END AS method, CASE ISNULL(p.PaymentType, 0) WHEN 1 THEN N'کارتخوان HIS' WHEN 2 THEN N'نقد HIS' WHEN 3 THEN N'کیف‌پول HIS' ELSE N'پرداخت HIS' END AS label, a.InsertDate AS transaction_date, a.InsertDate AS changed_at, CASE WHEN a.AdmissionNo IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE N'پذیرش ' + CAST(a.AdmissionNo AS nvarchar(64)) END AS notes FROM Accounting.Payment p INNER JOIN Accounting.CashPayment cp ON cp.PaymentId = p.Id INNER JOIN Admission.GeneralAdmission a ON a.Id = cp.AdmissionId INNER JOIN PID.Patient pt ON pt.Id = a.PatientId WHERE cp.AdmissionId IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(p.Amount, 0) > 0 AND (@LastId IS NULL OR p.Id > TRY_CAST(@LastId AS bigint)) ORDER BY p.Id ASC
